- FILE: scripts/workflow_retro.py
  Line or code reference: lines 492-518 (load_ai_memory_run_events inner loop)
  Problem: Malformed JSON lines and non-dict payloads are silently skipped (continue), hiding upstream data-quality defects. Streaming ingestion already handles OSError fail-open, but JSONDecodeError and non-dict payloads are dropped without trace.
  Why it fails at runtime: Incomplete weekly retro summaries can result with no operator-visible indication of malformed ledger data, making debugging harder and risking skewed outputs.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR

- FILE: scripts/workflow_retro.py
  Line or code reference: lines 500-506 (json.loads exception handler)
  Problem: Unconditional continue on json.JSONDecodeError masks data corruption; surrounding telemetry loops use continue for network/API transient failures, but local ledger corruption should be flagged for observability.
  Why it fails at runtime: Silent skipping can make partial summary data appear authoritative.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

- File: scripts/workflow_retro.py
  Line or code reference: load_ai_memory_run_events, json.JSONDecodeError handler inside the ledger streaming loop (last_run_diff, ~line 492-496 of the 824-line file)
  Problem: Malformed JSON lines in events.jsonl are silently skipped (continue on json.JSONDecodeError) without any accounting or visibility signal.
  Why it fails at runtime: When a ledger file contains one or more corrupted JSONL lines, those events disappear from the weekly retro summary with no warning. The retro output appears complete but may be missing data, and operators cannot diagnose or quantify the gap.
  SEVERITY: NIT

- File: scripts/workflow_retro.py
  Line or code reference: build_weekly_retro_payload, cost_telemetry = aggregate_run_cost_telemetry(runs) (unprotected call, PR diff ~line 570 area)
  Problem: The aggregate_run_cost_telemetry(runs) call is not wrapped in a try/except, inconsistent with the fail-open pattern applied to fetch_merged_pull_requests and load_ai_memory_run_events (both of which catch Exception and append a warning). If cost_audit.aggregate_run_cost_telemetry raises on an unexpected run structure, the entire retro fails (main exits with code 1) instead of producing partial output.
  Why it fails at runtime: If the cost telemetry parser encounters an unexpected data shape in the runs list, it can raise an unhandled exception that propagates through main(), killing the retro job even though all other data sources are healthy.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
